Against that, GAAP net income and net income available to common shareholders both fell, and the company-defined non-GAAP operating common income fell as well, so the softness is not merely a GAAP-versus-non-GAAP presentation artifact. The proximate composition of the decline is a swing in net investment securities results from a gain to a loss, a lower total noninterest income line, and a higher noninterest expense base, with a larger preferred dividend deduction further reducing the common-attributable result. The non-GAAP bridge also widened, with acquisition expense and total after-tax adjustments both larger, meaning more of the reported result is being added back; that is a question about run-rate earnings quality rather than a resolution of it. Credit is genuinely mixed rather than uniformly negative: charge-off flows and the charge-off rate rose and the nonaccrual and restructured loan stock and its ratio rose, while past-due balances fell, and these are point-in-time stocks and quarterly flows on different bases that cannot be netted into a single verdict. Conversely, evidence opposing an optimistic reading is that the non-GAAP operating measure fell too, so add-backs did not rescue the quarter, and the nonaccrual and restructured stock and ratio both rose alongside higher charge-offs, which points to a credit tail that is building even as past dues fall. reviews.rationale: Sequential comparison of selected SEC exhibit rows only; no year-over-year, guidance, or full-filing inference is made. The GAAP earnings chain weakened: net income and net income available to common shareholders both fell, with the decline concentrated in noninterest income, where a net investment securities gain in the prior quarter became a net loss, and in a higher noninterest expense base. Net interest income after provision rose modestly, so the core spread line did not deteriorate, but it was insufficient to offset the noninterest swing. The company-defined non-GAAP operating common income also declined, so the earnings softness is not solely a GAAP-versus-non-GAAP artifact; however, the non-GAAP reconciliation components (acquisition expense and total after-tax adjustments) expanded, meaning a larger share of the GAAP-to-non-GAAP bridge is being added back, which raises rather than resolves the question of underlying run-rate earnings quality. Credit evidence is genuinely mixed: net charge-offs and the charge-off rate rose, and the nonaccrual and restructured loan stock and its ratio rose, while loans over ninety days past due declined; these are point-in-time stocks and quarterly flows on different bases and cannot be netted into a single credit verdict. Preferred dividends rose, which further reduced the common-attributable result and is a capital-structure item rather than an operating driver. Tax expense fell in absolute terms alongside lower pretax income, so no tax-rate conclusion is drawn. Because the thesis is a source-bounded baseline record with no stated assumptions, catalysts, or invalidation conditions, and because the selected rows contain no segment, rate, balance, or management-commentary detail, the evidence supports maintaining the research state at the existing conviction rather than upgrading or invalidating it. The material uncertainty is attribution: the extract does not establish whether the securities swing, the expense increase, or the nonaccrual build reflect recurring conditions, acquisition effects, or timing, and it does not provide the loan or deposit balances needed to normalize the credit ratios. Evidence that would change the view includes full-filing detail on the composition of noninterest income and expense, the drivers of the nonaccrual increase, and whether the acquisition-related add-backs are transitional.
